protocol.fixedCheckpoints: Entry/final per phase, no best-checkpoint selection
limitations: Thermal initial baseline is not established
Remote control is not navigation/tool composition
No causal isolation of neutral pre-exposure benefit
One order, one new interaction, not universal adaptation

hypothesis.direction: first expanding-world learning and exploration pilot
hypothesis.falsification: Final300k only. Specific new-need acquisition requires on at least2/3 seeds: pressure q>=0.5 against preregistered strongest nonadaptive and joint-active audit means, and pressure improvement over the matched coverage-frozen policy >=0.2 of that audit gap. Full expanding-life adequacy additionally requires an acquired initial thermal skill and retention>=80% of its advantage. Otherwise full adequacy fails. Compare coverage/uniform descriptively per seed; do not infer causal pre-exposure transfer because exploration also differs after need introduction. Commands/both directions or reward alone cannot pass. FreezeAfter100k coverage prefix world/action hashes and entry weights must match coverage. Keep all seeds and final checkpoints; no tuning to this challenge.
hypothesis.statement: A controller frozen before the new workbench was authored can learn a newly valuable non-movement interaction during one continuous life; coverage-guided exploration is assessed separately from external drive motivation.
hypothesis.rationale: The original thermal preflight was behaviorally negative, so retention of an established thermal skill is explicitly not assumed. The new challenge tests genuinely new observation and action slots, a neutral interaction phase, and later an unweighted need. No brain edits after controller-freeze-01.

sources.sections: First end-to-end experiment and decision rules
sources.title: Live accepted research direction
sources.evidence: User-approved continuing expansion and independent autonomous exploration.
sources.implementationDifference: First minimal prototype has fixed generic random features, no prediction model and no full-life persistence.

sources.title: Unifying Count-Based Exploration and Intrinsic Motivation
sources.evidence: Counts in large state spaces need generalization; counts are not transition knowledge.
sources.implementationDifference: Bounded quantized observation-action counts choose exploratory candidates; no pseudo-count density model or reward bonus.

decisionRule: Final300k. New-need q>=.5 and matched-frozen pressure improvement>=.2*auditGap on2/3; full adequacy also requires acquired initial skill+80%retention. Verify equal coverage/frozen prefix hashes and entry weights. No tuning to challenge; retain every result.
